variables.description: The total enmity cap for a given entity on the enmity table. 30,000 is believed to be approximately current retail cap. This directly affects a tank's ability to hold enmity over time. The lower the value, the faster damage dealers will ...

variables.description: LandSandBoat map.lua setting: EXP_LOSS_RATE

variables.name: Capacity Rate
variables.description: Capacity Point Settings

variables.name: Fame Multiplier
variables.description: For old fame calculation use .25

variables.name: EXP Retain
variables.description: Percentage of experience normally lost to keep upon death. 0 means full loss, where 1 means no loss.

variables.name: EXP Loss Level
variables.description: Minimum level at which experience points can be lost

variables.name: Use Pre Abyssea EXP Loss Tiers
variables.description: Enable/Disable pre-Abyssea experience point loss tiers. set true with EXP_LOSS_LEVEL = 4, for pre-Abyssea experience point loss behavior. https://wiki.ffo.jp/html/15196.html

variables.name: Minimum Level Conquest Infuence Loss
variables.description: Minimum level at which regional influence is lost in conquest when a player dies Level 5 and below don't lose influence: http://wiki.ffo.jp/html/498.html

variables.name: Level Sync Enable
variables.description: Enable/disable Level Sync

variables.name: Disable Gear Scaling
variables.description: Disables ability to equip higher level gear when level cap/sync effect is on player.

variables.name: Disable Treasure Hunter Procs
variables.description: Disables Treasure Hunter procs (Era behavior wants this true)

variables.name: Enable Auto Attack Lua
variables.description: Enable auto attack damage calculations in Lua

variables.name: WS Points Base
variables.description: Weaponskill point base (before skillchain) for breaking latent - whole numbers only. retail is 5.

variables.name: WS Points Skillchain
variables.description: Weaponskill points per skillchain level - whole numbers only, retail is 2

variables.name: All Jobs Widescan
variables.description: Enable/disable jobs other than BST and RNG having widescan

variables.name: Base Speed
variables.description: Base player movement speed

variables.name: Speed Limit
variables.description: Player movement speed limit

variables.name: Mount Speed
variables.description: Mount speed, expressed as player speed. Can surpass speed limit.

variables.name: Animation Speed Divisor
variables.description: Player animation speed divisor Raising this increases the players movement animation speed

variables.name: MOB Run Speed Multiplier
variables.description: Multiplier for speed of engaged mobs when their target is out of range. The default for almost all mobs on retail is 2.5x their normal speed.

variables.name: Skillup Chance Multiplier
variables.description: Allows you to manipulate the constant multiplier in the skill-up rate formulas, having a potent effect on skill-up rates.

variables.name: Craft Chance Multiplier
variables.description: LandSandBoat map.lua setting: CRAFT_CHANCE_MULTIPLIER

variables.name: Skillup Amount Multiplier
variables.description: Multiplier for skillup amounts. Using anything above 1 will break the 0.5 cap, the cap will become 0.9 (For maximum, set to 5)

variables.name: Craft Amount Multiplier
variables.description: LandSandBoat map.lua setting: CRAFT_AMOUNT_MULTIPLIER

variables.name: Garden Day Matters
variables.description: Gardening Factors. DO NOT change defaults without verifiable proof that your change IS how retail does it. Myths need to be optional.

variables.name: Garden Moonphase Matters
variables.description: LandSandBoat map.lua setting: GARDEN_MOONPHASE_MATTERS

variables.name: Garden Pot Matters

variables.name: Garden Mh Aura Matters
variables.description: LandSandBoat map.lua setting: GARDEN_MH_AURA_MATTERS

variables.name: Craft Modern System
variables.description: Use current retail skill up rates and margins (Retail = High Skill-Up rate; Skill-Up when at or under 10 levels above synth recipe level.)

variables.name: Craft Common Cap
variables.description: Craft level limit from witch specialization points beginning to count. (Retail = 700; Level 75 era:600)

variables.name: Craft Specialization Points
variables.description: Amount of points allowed in crafts over the level defined above. Points are shared across all crafting skills. (Retail = 400; All skills can go to max = 3200)

variables.name: Craft HQ Chance Multiplier
variables.description: Multiplier applied to high quality chance

variables.name: Fishing Enable
variables.description: Enable/disable all fishing, including quests. ENABLE AT YOUR OWN RISK.

variables.name: Fishing Min Level
variables.description: Sets the minimum level a character must be to fish.

variables.name: Fishing Skill Multiplier
variables.description: Multiplier for fishing skill-up chance. Default = 1.0, very hard.

variables.name: Skillup Bloodpact
variables.description: Enable/disable skill-ups from bloodpacts

variables.name: MOB TP Multiplier
variables.description: Adjust rate of TP gain for mobs, pets (includes charmed pets), fellows, trusts and players. Acts as a multiplier, so default is 1.

variables.description: LandSandBoat map.lua setting: PET_TP_MULTIPLIER

variables.description: LandSandBoat map.lua setting: FELLOW_TP_MULTIPLIER

variables.name: NM HP Multiplier
variables.description: Adjust max HP pool for NMs, regular mobs, players, and trusts/fellows. Acts as a multiplier, so default is 1. Valid range: 0.1 to 2.0

variables.name: MOB HP Multiplier
variables.description: LandSandBoat map.lua setting: MOB_HP_MULTIPLIER

variables.name: Alter Ego HP Multiplier
variables.description: LandSandBoat map.lua setting: ALTER_EGO_HP_MULTIPLIER

variables.description: Adjust max MP pool for NMs, regular mobs, players, and trusts/fellows. Acts as a multiplier, so default is 1. Valid range: 0.1 to 2.0

variables.description: LandSandBoat map.lua setting: MOB_MP_MULTIPLIER

variables.name: Alter Ego MP Multiplier
variables.description: LandSandBoat map.lua setting: ALTER_EGO_MP_MULTIPLIER

variables.name: SJ MP Divisor
variables.description: Sets the fraction of MP a subjob provides to the main job. Retail is half and this acts as a divisor so default is 2

variables.name: Include MOB SJ
variables.description: Also adjust monsters subjob in ratio adjustments? 1 = true / 0 = false

variables.name: NM Stat Multiplier
variables.description: Adjust base stats (str/vit/etc.) for NMs, regular mobs, players, and trusts/fellows. Acts as a multiplier, so default is 1.0. Valid range: 0.1 to 2.0

variables.name: MOB Stat Multiplier
variables.description: LandSandBoat map.lua setting: MOB_STAT_MULTIPLIER

variables.name: Alter Ego Stat Multiplier
variables.description: LandSandBoat map.lua setting: ALTER_EGO_STAT_MULTIPLIER

variables.name: Alter Ego Skill Multiplier
variables.description: Adjust skill caps for trusts/fellows. Acts as a multiplier, so default is 1.

variables.name: Ability Recast Multiplier
variables.description: Adjust the recast time for abilities. Acts as a multiplier, so default is 1

variables.name: Spell Recast Reduction Cap
variables.description: Maximum spell recast reduction percentage. Current retail is 80. Older eras used 50.

variables.name: Blood Pact Shared Timer
variables.description: Enable/disable shared blood pact timer

variables.name: Drop Rate Multiplier
variables.description: Adjust mob drop rate. Acts as a multiplier, so default is 1.

variables.name: MOB Gil Multiplier
variables.description: Multiplier for gil naturally dropped by mobs. Does not apply to the bonus gil from all_mobs_gil_bonus. Default is 1.0.

variables.name: All Mobs Gil Bonus
variables.description: All mobs drop this much extra gil per mob LV even if they normally drop zero.

variables.name: Max Gil Bonus
variables.description: Maximum total bonus gil that can be dropped. Default 9999 gil.

variables.name: MOB No Despawn
variables.description: Allow mobs to walk back home instead of despawning

variables.name: MOB Additional Time To Deaggro
variables.description: Adds extra time to mob despawn in seconds. Base time is 25s, so a setting of 5 here would be a total of 30 seconds.

variables.name: Defensive Old Skillup Style
variables.description: Allows parry, block, and guard to skill up regardless of the action occuring. This did not happen in previous eras

variables.name: Battle Cap Tweak
variables.description: Globally adjusts ALL battlefield level caps by this many levels.

variables.name: LV Cap Mission BCNM
variables.description: Enable/disable level cap of mission battlefields stored in database.

variables.name: BCNM Enable Experimental
variables.description: Allow players to enter BCNMs which are flagged as experimental

variables.name: Max Merit Points
variables.description: Max allowed merits points players can hold 10 classic 30 abyssea

variables.name: Yell Cooldown
variables.description: Minimum time between uses of yell command (in seconds).

variables.name: Block Tell To Hidden GM
variables.description: Prevent players from sending tells to hidden GMs. You will still receive them from other GMs.

variables.name: Prevent Unengaged WS
variables.description: Prevent players from performing WS while unengaged using packet injection.

variables.name: Hide Readies Target
variables.description: Don't leak the target of non PCs readying items/casting spells/using mobskills. Essentially, server side kills the info the targetlines addon uses. This will also make battlemod/simplelog show self target on spells

variables.name: Audit GM Cmd
variables.description: Command Audit [logging] commands with lower permission than this will not be logged. Zero for no logging at all. Commands given to non GMs are not logged.

variables.name: Delivery Box Max Inflight
variables.description: Maximum number of in-flight items (slots) allowed in a player's delivery box for PC-to-PC transfers.

variables.name: Healing Tick Delay
variables.description: Seconds between healing ticks. Default is 10

variables.name: Keep Jugpet Through Zoning
variables.description: Enable/disable keeping jug pets through zoning

variables.name: Despawn Jugpets Below Minimum Level
variables.description: Despawn jug pets that have a minimum level below level sync or zone level restriction. Such as despawning Courier Carrie in a level 20 cap when their minimum level to summon is 23. While the default value of false is retail accurate, the...

variables.name: Report Lua Errors To Player Level
variables.description: Send stack traces to the client after caught Lua errors if their GM level is the same or higher than this number. The max GM level is 5, so setting this to 6 disables it for everone. Setting it to 0 enables for everyone.
